errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени по посока на часовниковата стрелка
errors.evidence: Describing the arrangement of two pie slices as 'clockwise' is ambiguous as there is no clear starting point, making the phrase unhelpful for understanding the layout.

errors.text_span: като по-големият сектор „Не“ заема лявата и долната част на диаграмата, а по-малкият „Да“ — дясната и горната част
errors.evidence: This description over-generalizes the position of the slices. The dividing line between them is nearly vertical, meaning the 'Не' slice is on the left and the 'Да' slice is on the right. Attributing 'bottom' and 'top' positions is inaccurate.
